### Sound Pack Details
- **Sound Name(s) Included:** (e.g., Doorbell Chime, Smoke Alarm, Mechanical Keyboard)
- **Environment / Recording Notes:** (e.g., Quiet indoor room, ~1m from microphone)
- **Language / Region Tag:** (e.g., EN / PT-BR)

### Privacy Confirmation
- [x] I confirm this submission contains **only mathematical 521-dim neural embedding vectors** generated by HeardWord Studio and **no raw audio files**.
